svg.title: PILGRIM — 3x3 Circle Grid
svg.desc: Nine parchment spaces on a green hexagon: eight named actions around a central City, linked by clockwise ring arrows and four arrows to and from the middle. Each space shows its cube counts as four columns on a shared baseline.

text.tspan: Eight action spaces around a central City, sown clockwise. Each space shows how many cubes
each player has there, as four columns on a shared baseline.
